fusions.name: Discharge the Shell
fusions.desc: Releases the arcana soaked into your shell, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Muddling Mote
fusions.desc: Throws a mote of raw arcana that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spell-Turning Dome
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, your shell turns 40% of the elemental damage you take back on whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Ward Woven In
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and your arcane resistance by 10%.
